Select distinct molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles for compounds tested in Homo sapiens assays against target CHEMBL1936. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then to assays, then to target_dictionary. Filter assays.assay_organism = 'Homo sapiens' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1936'. Inner join compound_structures to require canonical_smiles. Return distinct rows sorted by compound_chembl_id and canonical_smiles.
